title: Dispute Allowances for Seller Feedback and Product Reviews, by Seller Performance Standing Level
content:
How many seller feedback and product review disputes a seller may submit in a calendar month depends on the seller's Seller Performance Standing level; the dispute window and the removable reasons are the same at every level.

## Monthly dispute allowance

| Level | Seller feedback and product review disputes per calendar month |
|---|---|
| Below Standard Level | 5 |
| Developing Seller Level | 5 |
| Standard Level | 10 |
| Above Standard Level | 15 |
| Top Rated Level | 25 |
| Preferred Partner Level | 50 |

## Terms identical at every level

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Dispute window — calendar days after the feedback or review was left within which it may be disputed | 90 |
| Reasons for which seller feedback is removed when the records support them | review about product not seller; contains personal or obscene content; Fulfilled by Northloop fulfillment experience; buyer retracted |
| Reasons for which a product review is removed when the records support them | conflict of interest; incentivized review; contains personal or obscene content; review about seller not product |
| Negative feedback solely about the delivery of a Fulfilled by Northloop order is struck | yes |

## Points of reading

- The two reason lists are not interchangeable. "Contains personal or obscene content" appears on both; "review about product not seller", "Fulfilled by Northloop fulfillment experience" and "buyer retracted" are reasons for seller feedback only; "conflict of interest", "incentivized review" and "review about seller not product" are reasons for product reviews only.
- Hypothetical example: a seller placed at Standard Level has 10 disputes for the month; a seller placed at Top Rated Level has 25.
